topic_description: Research studies about the usage of AI in schools for education purposes. Include papers showing how AI can be used for education purposes during school time in a classroom. Exclude papers that focus on different technological implementations of AI. Focus on different ways to use AI in schools and its impact on learning and students.
provider_reason: OpenAlex is ideal for a broad scholarly search across disciplines, making it a good default provider for this topic.
search_goal: To find approximately 30 research papers discussing the usage of AI in educational settings within schools, highlighting practical applications rather than technological implementations.
main_search_string: AI in schools for education practical applications
alternate_search_strings: impact of AI on student learning
using AI to enhance education in schools
